# E0217: a minor version narrows the field names a struct accepts

A struct written with `...` accepts any field name; its instances may hold
fields the schema never names. A minor version that closes the struct, or
narrows it to a pattern, rejects those instances.

## Example

`lineage.cue`:

```cue
name: "ship"
schemas: {
	"0": {
		"0": {
			schema: {
				a: int
				...
			}
		}
		"1": {
			schema: {
				a: int
			}
		}
	}
}
```

thema reports:

```
error[E0217]: schema 0.1 accepts any field name in the prior schema and is closed in the new one
  --> lineage.cue:11:4
   |
11 |             schema: {
   |             ^^^^^^
   |
   = note: schema 0.1 is a minor version, so it must accept all data schema 0.0 accepts
   = help: make the change compatible, or make this version 1.0
```
